messages:
tom: quick thought — could we add a `--quick` flag to /deploy that expands a tiny shorthand into a full param set? saves typing during on-call.
heidi: like `/deploy --quick=staging-small` that expands to all flags? yes pls. but we need lint checks.
ops_lead: support as long as quick presets are versioned and auditable. we can't have magic one-off commands without history.
deploy-bot: proposal: implement quick presets as named aliases that resolve to a profile + param set. commands: `/deploy quick save <name> --spec '<json>'`, `/deploy quick list`, `/deploy --quick <name> [--dry-run|--simulate]`.
tom: also want a `--why` flag that prints the audit link + who last edited the preset. helps oncalls.
heidi: small UX example:
```
/deploy quick save ramp-promo --spec '{"pin":"svc@sha:aaa","stages":[{"pct":5,"mins":15},{"pct":25,"mins":30}],"rollback":{"enabled":true,"error_delta_pct":4},"notes":"promo ramp for campaign X"}'
/deploy --quick=ramp-promo --dry-run --why
```
qa: we'll need a quick test harness. suggest a `--simulate` that takes a small CSV of synthetic metrics and returns whether rollback would have triggered and when. useful for rehearsals.
ops_lead: Good. Also require `--approved-by=<user>` for any quick that targets prod or >20% traffic. Approval recorded to audit log.
release-manager: can release notes be auto-populated from the preset's `notes` field? that'd cut down manual copy.
deploy-bot: yes, if `notes` exists I'll attach to the release draft and include a link to the quick preset.
heidi: security: encrypt presets at rest and restrict list to org roles; maybe a `public` vs `private` flag.
tom: edge cases: if preset missing pin and canary>0.25, lint should fail unless `--force` with 2 approvers.
ops_lead: include an escape hatch endpoint: `/deploy quick abort <run_id>` and `/deploy quick rollback <run_id>`; both should create an incident log. abort should stop auto-rollback for that run and require manual resolution.
qa: test plan: 1) unit tests for serialization/deserialization, 2) simulated run using csv metrics, 3) integration test with console metrics pipeline to verify triggers.
deploy-bot: CI note: add schema validation, migrator for existing ad-hoc env vars to quick presets, and an endpoint to list history: `/deploy quick history <name>`.
release-manager: action items: tom to draft RFC + example presets, heidi to prototype lint + simulate, ops to define approval gating, qa to write tests. i'll handle release note wiring.
tom: i'll open the RFC this afternoon and include a short migration plan. i'll ping when it's up.
ops_lead: thanks — please include retention rules for presets (who can delete, TTL on old versions) and make sure audit trail is exportable for compliance.
heidi: noted. i'll start a spike branch for `quick` CLI and post link.
qa: adding test harness ticket QAT-711.
deploy-bot: reminder: dry-run will always log but not execute; simulate mode returns a timeline of expected rollouts.
release-manager: :+1: let's run this on non-critical services for 2 weeks before expanding.
